t: One of the five Deccan sultanates that replaced the Bahmani Sultanate, ruled by the Adil Shahi dynasty from Bijapur.
It joined the coalition that defeated Vijayanagara at Talikota in 1565 and later conquered much of southern Karnataka.
Squeezed by the Mughals and the rising Marathas, it fell to Aurangzeb after a long siege in 1686.
dyk: The Gol Gumbaz in Bijapur, tomb of Muhammad Adil Shah, has a whispering gallery under its dome where a whisper can be heard clearly on the far side.
ev: Yusuf Adil Khan makes himself independent at Bijapur
The Portuguese capture Goa from Bijapur
Bijapur and its allies defeat Vijayanagara at the Battle of Talikota
Ibrahim Adil Shah II annexes the Bidar Sultanate
Treaty with Shah Jahan makes Bijapur a Mughal tributary
Shivaji kills the Bijapur general Afzal Khan at Pratapgad
Aurangzeb takes Bijapur after a siege of more than a year
